name: Daily Digest Emails for WooCommerce
author: wpspin

sections.description:
📊 Daily Digest Emails for WooCommerce delivers a once-per-day snapshot of your store’s performance directly to your inbox. No more logging into wp-admin just to check how your store is doing — get everything you need in one clean email.

✨ What You Get

  • 💰 Revenue totals — Daily sales at a glance
  • 📦 Order counts by status — Pending, processing, completed, and more
  • 🛒 Recent orders list — Order number, status, total, and quick edit links
  • ✉️ HTML & Plain text — Choose your preferred email format
  • 👥 Multiple recipients — Send to your whole team
  • ⚙️ Native WooCommerce integration — Settings live right where you expect them

🎯 10 Use Cases

  1. Store owners — Wake up to a daily performance summary without logging in
  2. Fulfillment teams — Get pending order counts to plan the day’s workload
  3. Accountants & bookkeepers — Track daily revenue for reconciliation
  4. Dropshippers — Monitor order volume across multiple stores
  5. Marketing teams — Correlate campaign launches with order spikes
  6. Customer support — Know what’s in the queue before opening tickets
  7. Business partners — Keep stakeholders informed without admin access
  8. Virtual assistants — Receive order summaries to manage client stores
  9. Warehouse managers — Plan inventory and shipping based on order status
  10. Agency owners — Monitor client stores from a single inbox

🔧 Setup (Takes 2 Minutes)

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Emails → Daily Digest
  3. Add recipient email(s) — separate multiple with commas
  4. Choose HTML or Plain text format
  5. Customize subject line and heading (optional)
  6. Done! Your first digest arrives within 24 hours

🤝 Works Great With

  • WooCommerce Subscriptions — Track recurring revenue
  • WooCommerce Admin — Enhanced analytics dashboard
  • Metorik — Advanced reporting alongside daily digests
  • ShipStation — Fulfillment teams get order counts before syncing
  • Klaviyo / Mailchimp — Marketing attribution with daily sales data
  • QuickBooks / Xero — Daily revenue for bookkeeping workflows
  • Slack via Zapier — Forward digests to team channels
  • Google Sheets via Zapier — Log daily totals automatically

🔒 Compatibility

  • ✅ WooCommerce 6.0+
  • ✅ WordPress 6.0+
  • ✅ HPOS / Custom Order Tables
  • ✅ WooCommerce Blocks
  • ✅ PHP 7.4+
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via Plugins → Add New in WordPress
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce → Settings → Emails → Daily Digest
  4. Configure recipients, subject line, and email format
  5. Save changes — your digest is now scheduled!
sections.faq:
Can I send the digest to multiple people?

Yes! Enter multiple email addresses separated by commas in the Recipient(s) field.

Does the plugin send HTML or plain text?

Both templates are included. Choose your preferred format in WooCommerce → Settings → Emails → Daily Digest.

How do I change the send time?

The digest uses WordPress cron. Use the wcdd_schedule_recurrence filter or a cron management plugin to adjust timing.

Will this work with HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage)?

Yes, the plugin is fully compatible with WooCommerce’s custom order tables feature.

Can I customize the email content?

Yes! Override the templates in your theme at yourtheme/woocommerce/emails/ for full control.
